consumerNotes.audit-bm-final: When this file exists at docs/audit/bm-visual-signoff/<TEMPLATE>/manual-approval.latest.json AND its `decision === 'GRANTED'` AND `visualSignoffGranted === true` AND the file's `reviewedDocxSha256` matches the rendered DOCX sha256 that audit:bm-final would derive for this BM, the harness MAY treat the style section's status as PASS for this BM only. The harness must keep the rolloutReady gate at status==='PASS' && safety.* green and must NOT flip rolloutReady for any other BM.
consumerNotes.audit-bm-rollout-ready: When this file exists, decision=GRANTED, visualSignoffGranted=true, and reviewedDocxSha256 matches the rendered DOCX the rollout-ready gate's gate-15 evaluation composes against, the gate MAY treat gate 15 as PASS (instead of MANUAL_REQUIRED). Other gates are unaffected. The rolloutReady boolean only flips to true when every gate (1..15) is PASS / NOT_APPLICABLE.
